newReleases.name: Have Words
newReleases.desc:
Have Words is a two-player word game of trap and dodge.

Play a friend across the world, pass a phone across the table, or take on a bot.

Take turns adding letters to a growing word fragment. Finish a word, you lose the round. Every move must keep the fragment on a path to a real word, and a dubious opponent can challenge you to name one. It's a race toward a word you must never finish. Outmaneuver your opponent letter by letter until the only move they have left completes the word.

Rounds play for a tally that grows with every letter. Push it higher when you like your position, bail out when it turns on you. Losers pay, winners collect, and the match ends when one of you runs dry.

Ways to play:

Friends over Game Center, whenever you each get a moment
Pass and play on one device
Named bots with their own styles, fun to lose to

The entire game is free, now and forever: every rule, every mode, every bot. Choice Words is a one time purchase that lets you run several matches at once and opens all nine color schemes instead of one. No ads, no subscriptions, nothing else to sell you.

newReleases.name: Petalbound
newReleases.desc:
Welcome to Petalbound, an eastern fantasy garden awakening through mist, petals, and morning dew.

Connect neighboring blooms of the same color and watch the garden unfold through cascading clears. Every successful bloom consumes dew, so each move asks you to observe the board, anticipate falling pieces, and use special garden elements with care.

• Seven themed gardens and 154 campaign stages
• Connected-group clearing with cascading bloom reactions
• A limited-dew system that rewards thoughtful planning
• Thorns, moon blooms, stone walls, gravity, and combined challenges
• Optional Hint, Shuffle, and Dew tools
• A sixty-second Endless Tide mode
• Daily quests and a weekly vine milestone trail
• 36 achievement seals and 40 botanical collection entries
• No account required and playable offline
• Simplified Chinese and English support
• Reduced-motion support

Observe, connect, and bloom your way through a calm garden journey.

newReleases.name: Hyperslot
newReleases.desc:
Walls rush at you down a neon corridor. Each one has a gap. Be in it.

Hyperslot is a one-life arcade runner built for quick, intense runs. Drag your cube into the gap before the wall arrives, then do it again, faster, with a pounding techno soundtrack that speeds up with you. There is no finish line: the walls never stop getting quicker, and your score is how far you get.

EASY TO LEARN, IMPOSSIBLE TO MASTER
- Drag to slide one cell at a time, flick to dash to the wall
- Gaps slide, walls rotate, walls black out, and double, triple and quadruple walls chain together
- Every wall is generated to be passable: if you miss, it was you

PLAY AT YOUR SPEED
- X1 for the classic game
- X1.5 and X2 for experts, worth 2 and 4 points per gap
- X0.5 practice mode to learn the walls

SIX TESSERACT CUBES
Pick from six four-dimensional cubes, each with its own glow and trail, from the white-hot Reactor to the colour-shifting Spectrum.

A SOUNDTRACK THAT FOLLOWS YOU
Original four-on-the-floor techno that speeds up as the walls do, without losing its groove.

COMPETE
Game Center leaderboards for friends and the world.

Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking.

newReleases.name: Park Right Here
newReleases.desc:
A little farther. Straighten the wheel. Reverse gently.
Can you fit this car into that space?

Park Right Here is a single-player 3D parking game about careful control. Use the steering wheel, accelerator, brake, and forward/reverse gears to line up your car and stop inside the marked space without bumping into your surroundings.

18 STAGES, 6 CHAPTERS
Clear courses and move on to the next parking challenge. Timed stages ask you to balance patience with pace. Find a better approach angle, adjust your steering, and make each maneuver count in low-poly parking environments.

54 STARS TO COLLECT
Each stage offers up to three stars. A clear is only the beginning: revisit courses, improve your performance, and fill in the stars you missed. See your progress and aim for a complete collection.

WORK TOWARD A PLATINUM LICENSE
Your total stars advance your in-game license from Green to Blue, Gold, and finally Platinum. Finish the last course, then take on the next goal: all 54 stars. Complete the collection for a special celebration.

PRECISION COUNTS
Mistakes such as collisions add penalty points. Speed alone is not enough. Learn when to brake, when to straighten up, and when to try a different approach.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No account or login is required. Adjust steering sensitivity in Settings to find a feel that suits you.

SCRAM is the #1 hide and seek game for the real world. Split into hunters and runners, start the clock, and play across your street, park, campus or campsite, with your phone keeping score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Runners get a head start to hide.
• Every few minutes the hunters get a ping: each runner's location pops up on their map, marked with how long ago it was.
• Each team sees its own players live. Between pings the hunters are guessing, and runners never see the hunters at all.
• The play zone shrinks as the clock runs down. Stay outside it for 30 seconds and the hunters see you live. Stay out for 2 minutes and you're out.
• Tag someone in person and they tap "I got tagged".

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: tagged runners are out and watch the rest of the round live. The hunters try to tag everyone, and any runner still free when time runs out wins.
• Infection: every tag switches sides. Tagged runners join the hunters, so the hunt grows as the round goes on. Survive the clock to win.
The host picks the mode, and can change it in the lobby.

YOU SET THE RULES
Start from a preset (Quick, Standard or Big park) or save your own. The host picks the round length, the head start, how often the pings come (or none at all), and the play zone: its size, where it sits, and how often it shrinks. Or switch the zone off and play anywhere.

EASY TO JOIN
Friends join with the six-character game code, an invite link that opens the game in SCRAM, or the QR code in the lobby.

MADE FOR PLAYING OUT

The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.

all.name: SCRAM: Hide and Seek
all.desc:
SCRAM is the #1 hide and seek game for the real world. Split into hunters and runners, start the clock, and play across your street, park, campus or campsite, with your phone keeping score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Runners get a head start to hide.
• Every few minutes the hunters get a ping: each runner's location pops up on their map, marked with how long ago it was.
• Each team sees its own players live. Between pings the hunters are guessing, and runners never see the hunters at all.
• The play zone shrinks as the clock runs down. Stay outside it for 30 seconds and the hunters see you live. Stay out for 2 minutes and you're out.
• Tag someone in person and they tap "I got tagged".

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: tagged runners are out and watch the rest of the round live. The hunters try to tag everyone, and any runner still free when time runs out wins.
• Infection: every tag switches sides. Tagged runners join the hunters, so the hunt grows as the round goes on. Survive the clock to win.
The host picks the mode, and can change it in the lobby.

YOU SET THE RULES
Start from a preset (Quick, Standard or Big park) or save your own. The host picks the round length, the head start, how often the pings come (or none at all), and the play zone: its size, where it sits, and how often it shrinks. Or switch the zone off and play anywhere.

EASY TO JOIN
Friends join with the six-character game code, an invite link that opens the game in SCRAM, or the QR code in the lobby.

MADE FOR PLAYING OUT

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

all.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
all.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h

all.name: Meowdoku!
all.desc:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress.
